title: Identity Provider
description: Schema for identity provider definitions in CerberAuth identity provider data.

$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema defining this document.

name.description: Display name of the identity provider.

abstract.description: Brief summary or overview of the identity provider.

identifier.description: Unique machine-readable identifier (slug) of the identity provider.

type.description: How the provider is delivered. "platform" is a standalone identity service or server (hosted or self-hosted) that applications integrate with over protocols such as OIDC or SAML. "library" is embedded in the host application's own codebase, runtime and database. Defaults to "platform" when omitted.

languages.description: Programming languages or runtimes a library can be embedded in. Only meaningful when type is "library".

status.description: Lifecycle status of the provider. "active" is maintained and sold. "deprecated" is still available but discouraged by its maintainer. "end_of_life" is discontinued or no longer maintained. "acquired" was bought and its product is being merged into the acquirer's offering. Defaults to "active" when omitted.

deploymentModels.description: Ways the provider can be run. "saas" is vendor-hosted, "self_hosted" is run on infrastructure the customer operates, "hybrid" splits components between vendor and customer infrastructure, "embedded" runs inside the host application (libraries).

targetAudience.description: Audiences the provider is built for.

icon.description: Icon information for the identity provider.

contentUrl.description: URL pointing to the icon/logo asset.

website.description: Official website URL of the provider.

github.description: GitHub repository URL of the provider.

repositories.description: Source repositories of the product. SDK repositories are listed in sdks instead of here unless they are the product itself.

lastRelease.description: Publication date of the latest release.

statsUpdatedAt.description: Date stars, contributors, latestVersion and lastRelease were fetched. Refreshed by npm run stats.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or expression (e.g. Apache-2.0, MIT, AGPL-3.0-only). Use "Proprietary" for closed-source or commercial licenses that have no SPDX identifier.

licenseUrl.description: URL to the license text or the LICENSE file of the project.

openSource.description: Open-source status of the product itself, as opposed to its SDKs.

isOpenSource.description: Whether the core product is released under an OSI-approved license.

model.description: "fully_open" has no paid-only features in the open-source code. "open_core" keeps some features in a paid edition. "source_available" publishes the code under a non-open-source license.

nationality.description: Country of origin or headquarters of the identity provider.

vendor.description: Company that currently develops and sells the product (e.g. Red Hat for Keycloak, Twilio for Stytch).

foundedYear.description: Year the company that originally built the product was founded, or the year the project started when it predates the company.

headquarters.description: Headquarters of the vendor. Omitted when sources disagree on it.

acquiredBy.description: Company that acquired the company that originally built the product.

pricing.description: Pricing details and plan tiers for the identity provider.

hasFreeTier.description: Indicates whether a free tier, free edition, or free trial is available.

freeTierLimit.description: Details and limits associated with the free tier.

freeTierMau.description: Monthly active users included for free in the hosted offering. Omitted when unlimited, not counted in MAU, or there is no free tier.

pricingUrl.description: URL to the provider's official pricing page.

hasEnterprisePlan.description: Whether a dedicated enterprise plan or tier is listed.

contactSalesRequired.description: Whether at least one plan is only available by contacting sales.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the amounts in the plans (e.g. USD, EUR).

price.description: Price or pricing description for the plan.

amount.description: Machine-readable flat fee of the plan in pricing.currency, charged every period. Omitted for per-unit, usage-based, ranged and custom prices, which stay in price.

period.description: Billing period the amount covers. Required when amount is greater than zero.

mauIncluded.description: Monthly active users included in the plan price.

featuresIncluded.description: Identifiers of the features that list this plan in their plans. Features available on every plan are not repeated here.

hosting.description: Where and how the product can be hosted.

regions.description: Data residency regions of the hosted offering. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, or an area code: EU, APAC (Asia-Pacific), SAM (South America), MEA (Middle East and Africa).

selfHostRequirements.description: What is needed to run the product on your own infrastructure.

runtime.description: Language runtime or platform the product runs on (e.g. Go, Java 21+, .NET).

container.description: Supported container and orchestration tooling (e.g. Docker, Helm, Kubernetes).

sla.description: Contractual or published uptime commitment of the hosted offering.

scope.description: Plans or products the commitment applies to (e.g. "Enterprise plan").

lastVerified.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the data in this file was last checked against the provider.

sdks.description: Client, server and mobile SDKs the provider publishes for integrating with it.

framework.description: Framework or platform the SDK targets (e.g. React, Android, Spring Boot).

url.description: URL of the SDK repository or documentation.

official.description: Whether the SDK is maintained by the provider itself.

features.description: List of Identity and Access Management (IAM) features supported by the provider.

category.description: Category identifier that this feature belongs to.

description.description: Implementation details, limitations, or notes about the feature support.

links.description: Documentation or reference URLs for the feature.

plans.description: List of plan names that include or enable this feature.

values.description: Supported options, platforms, regions, or languages for this feature.

tier.description: Provider-specific tier of the feature. Differs from the catalog tier in definitions/tiers.json.

sinceVersion.description: Product version that introduced the feature.

betaStatus.description: Release stage of the feature. Defaults to "ga" when omitted.

oidc.description: OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 protocol specifications and capabilities.

features.description: List of OIDC and OAuth features, grant types, endpoints, and profiles.

identifier.description: Unique identifier or URN of the OIDC feature or grant type.

status.description: Support status of the OIDC feature.

description.description: Detailed description or implementation notes regarding OIDC support.

links.description: Documentation or RFC specification URLs for this OIDC feature.

tier.description: Provider-specific tier of the feature. Differs from the catalog tier in definitions/tiers.json.

sinceVersion.description: Product version that introduced the feature.

betaStatus.description: Release stage of the feature. Defaults to "ga" when omitted.
